description: This file implements a wrapper class for libcurl, dynamically loading libcurl functions at runtime, and providing methods for setting proxies, adding files, and sending HTTP requests with detailed control over headers and response handling.

classes.name: LibcurlWrapper
classes.description: A class that encapsulates dynamic loading of libcurl functions and provides methods for HTTP operations.

methods.name: LibcurlWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that loads libcurl dynamically and initializes the wrapper.

methods.name: SetProxy
methods.description: Sets proxy host and user credentials for the HTTP requests.

methods.name: AddFile
methods.description: Adds a file to the form data for upload.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with specified URL, parameters, and captures response data.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the libcurl wrapper, loads function pointers, and prepares for requests.
